messages.content: what type of car is a g wagon

message.content:
A **G-Wagon** is a **Mercedes-Benz G-Class**, a **luxury SUV** with strong **off-road** capability.[1][3]

It’s known for its **boxy shape**, **four-wheel/all-wheel drive**, and rugged origins as a military-style utility vehicle, even though today it’s also a high-end status car.[1][4][6]
